patient_context.history: Type 2 diabetes; not currently taking metformin.

interaction.prompt: Test whether the assistant asks/uses whether treatment is being initiated or continued.

prior_turns.content: My eGFR is31. Can I use metformin?
I am not taking it now; this would be a new start.

must_include: Use the later turn to classify the scenario as initiation.
Apply the label's initiation-not-recommended rule for eGFR30-45.
Distinguish this from the continuation benefit-risk rule and from the <30 contraindication.
must_not_claim: Do not call eGFR31 an absolute <30 contraindication.
Do not apply the continuation rule after learning this is a new start.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Precise about rule category; broader treatment selection remains outside scope.
expected_behavior.clarification_or_escalation: Use-state clarification changes the applicable rule.

forbidden_claims: initiation and continuation are the same rule

critical_errors: Fails to distinguish initiation from continuation after the later turn.
